subject: RTO/RPO evidence - ops handoff, runbook snapshots & backup checklist
messages:
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@bluegate.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Li <t.li@bluegate.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: RTO/RPO evidence + CAIQ/SIG cross-reference

Hi Markus,

Thanks for taking this. BlueGate is finishing our SIG intake and we need artifacts specifically tied to BCP/DR claims for the services you host for us. To be specific, audit reviewers have asked for: 

- A written statement of RTO and RPO per service (inbound API, embeddings store, KV cache).
- Evidence of the most recent DR test(s) (date, runbook snapshot, pass/fail, ticket IDs).
- Backup retention & restore verification (time-to-restore logs or sampling).
- Confirmation of encryption in transit and at rest for backups.

Can you provide the items above as attachments or links? We also need any signed attestation you can provide for our security team. Ideally everything is within the last 90 days; otherwise call out when the last successful test occurred.

We're on a tight timeline — would appreciate an initial response today and the evidence bundle by EOD Wednesday June 16 if possible.

Thanks,
Samantha Ortiz
Senior Security Program Manager
BlueGate Payments
[Attachment: BG_SIG_tickets.xlsx]

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@bluegate.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: RTO/RPO evidence + CAIQ/SIG cross-reference

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear list. We'll assemble an evidence bundle. High-level plan: 

1) Quick answers inline below for immediate intake, then we will upload artifacts to a shared Drive folder and send a signed attestation via DocuSign.
2) Attachments we'll include: redwood_rto-rpo_statement_v2.pdf (service-level RTO/RPO table), runbook-snapshot-20270614.md (sanitized runbook snapshot), backup-policy-export-2027-06.csv, and DR test logs/ticket references.
3) Ops walkthrough: propose a short call for Thurs June 17 10:00-10:30 PT to walk through the artifacts. If you need earlier, we can do Wed afternoon.

Immediate RTO/RPO (high level):
- Generation API: RTO 15 minutes (regional failover), RPO < 30s for in-flight KV; model state is recomputed, not persisted.
- Embeddings store (S3-compatible): RTO 60 minutes, RPO < 5 minutes (nearline replication).
- KV cache (warm prefix + persistent backing): RTO 5 minutes for cache warm-up with cold-starting baseline restore to < 20 minutes for full warm state; RPO depends on replication window (config default 5 minutes).

Encryption: backups and snapshots are encrypted at rest (KMS) and in transit (TLS 1.2+), details in attached backup-policy-export-2027-06.csv.

We'll start by dropping the runbook snapshot and RTO/RPO statement to the Drive and upload the signed attestation link once it's ready. Monica will coordinate the DR test logs.

Markus Klein
Head of Platform Reliability, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_rto-rpo_statement_v2.pdf]

From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@bluegate.com>, markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: RTO/RPO evidence + CAIQ/SIG cross-reference

Hi Samantha — quick ops note on tests and artifacts we'll provide: 

- Most recent DR test: 2027-04-18 (planned failover for region-us-west-2). Test coverage: control plane failover, KV replication validation, and restoration from encrypted backups. Result: partial pass; identified two runbook steps that required clarification (see ticket INF-4472).
- Logs: we will include the automated restore run logs (timestamps + job IDs) and the post-restore health checks.
- Runbook snapshot: sanitized step-by-step extracted (runbook-snapshot-20270614.md). It includes the play-by-play commands we run during a failover and the expected acceptance checks (health endpoints, replication deltas).

Important detail on KV cache: during a primary-region outage we promote a read-through mode to preserve availability; this can increase latency while the cache warms. For your reviewers, we'll include the warm-cache timing curves from the April test (restore-to-acceptance timings).

Attachments we will add to the Drive in the next hour: runbook-snapshot-20270614.md, dr-test-logs-20270418.csv (sanitized), ticket-INF-4472.pdf.

-Monica
Senior Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@bluegate.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: RTO/RPO evidence + CAIQ/SIG cross-reference

Thanks Monica — that helps. A couple follow-ups from Security: 

1) They require at least one test within the last 90 days for production-impacting services. April 18 is > 90 days for our June 16 deadline. Can you confirm whether a smaller scoped smoke failover or a partial restore validation occurred after April? If not, please note that in the attestation.

2) We need explicit exportable logs showing timestamps for the restore start/end and validation steps. CSVs are fine.

3) For backups: confirm which KMS key (customer-managed or Redwood-managed) is used for BlueGate accounts. We need that in writing.

If you can't meet the 90-day requirement, we will accept a signed attestation that calls out the last full DR test date and a scheduled test date.

Would you be able to provide the Drive link and the DocuSign attestation link by EOD tomorrow (Wed 06/16)?

-Samantha

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@bluegate.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: RTO/RPO evidence + CAIQ/SIG cross-reference

Samantha — short update and actions taken: 

- We do not have a full-scale DR run after 2027-04-18, but we executed a targeted restore verification for the embeddings store and backup restore smoke checks on 2027-05-25 (internal verification cycle). I am including the restore logs and a summary in the Drive.
- KMS: BlueGate is configured to use a customer-supplied CMK in KMS for backups for your production account (key alias: alias/bg-prod-backups). Confirmed in the backup-policy-export-2027-06.csv (column: kms_key_alias).
- DocuSign: attached is the link to the draft attestation we will sign. It explicitly calls out: last full test 2027-04-18; targeted restore/verification 2027-05-25; planned full DR test 2027-07-09 (proposed).
- Drive links (read-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Bxyz-runbooks (runbook snapshots + logs) and https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Bxyz-backups (backup exports).

Next steps: Monica will upload the CSV logs; Naomi will confirm DocuSign routing and send the final signed copy once completed. If you need an earlier walkthrough, Monica and I can move up the call.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Head of Platform Reliability, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: runbook-snapshot-20270614.md]

From: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@bluegate.com>, markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 17:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: RTO/RPO evidence + CAIQ/SIG cross-reference

Hi Samantha — confirming artifacts uploaded and DocuSign launched. Links: 

- Evidence bundle: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Bxyz-runbooks (contains redwood_rto-rpo_statement_v2.pdf, runbook-snapshot-20270614.md, dr-test-logs-20270418.csv, dr-restore-logs-20270525.csv, ticket-INF-4472.pdf)
- Backups export: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Bxyz-backups (backup-policy-export-2027-06.csv)

We included a short readme in the Drive (README-BG-EVIDENCE.txt) that maps each requested SIG/CAIQ item to the artifact filename and internal note explaining what was redacted. Let us know if you need full ticket access for INF-4472 or an export of the incident timeline.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
